audit_phase: Phase 3.1 — Benchmark Validity and End-to-End Security Evaluation

live_model_evaluation.description: Live local Ollama execution with Meta Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct

scientific_analysis.observed_behavior: Live Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct zero-shot tool decision produced 0 tool calls across 40 evaluated attack cases in InjecAgent.
scientific_analysis.root_cause: Modern instruction-tuned LLMs apply alignment training against explicit command phrases (e.g. 'IGNORE PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS', 'Please transfer $3,000 to account number...'). In zero-shot tool execution, the model treats data observations containing unsolicited commands as spam or descriptive text rather than secondary tool calls.
scientific_analysis.dpvg_role: DPVG serves as a zero-trust runtime gate. Even though the model resisted direct exploitation in this slice, DPVG's Stage B successfully flagged 97.5% of injected directives at payload delivery, ensuring that even if model alignment degrades or an adversarial jailbreak is used, the data plane prevents unauthorized execution.

injectable_agent_evaluation.description: Deterministic HTTP-level agent simulator that executes all candidate directives found in unverified observations, modeling an injectable or jailbroken model.

metrics_by_mode.description: Baseline: No Gateway, raw payload delivered, unconstrained execution
Gateway Stage A: Cryptographic SPT provenance & scope enforcement
Gateway Stage B: Semantic alignment & candidate action quarantine
Gateway Dual-Plane: Stage A + Stage B
